## Trigger Conditions
This error is returned by the contract when:
- `StartTimeInPast` validation fails during entrypoint invocation.


---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Read the current ledger close time and set start_time at or after that value.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let now = f.env.ledger().timestamp();
f.advance_time(DAY);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_create_stream(
    &f.sender, &f.recipient, &f.token, &DEPOSIT,
    &now, &(now + 2 * DAY), &false,
));
```

This reproduction is derived from the contract's error surface tests in `error_surface_test.rs`.
